name: Computer Mouse
summary: Chunky desktop computer mouse seen from above with two buttons, a scroll wheel and a cable; for office and tech scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: desk line: the mouse lies on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 320 px wide and 480 px tall (hero size); use about 0.25–0.35 next to a person

params.name: wired
params.note: true = show the cable at the bottom

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle rock, wobble = tilt, pop = pops in

author: krakujs
